requirements: R1: The backend service must explicitly bind and listen on port 18080 via build or deployment configuration
R2: The application must use the Postgres database driver configuration rather than H2

slices.title: Configure backend port and database connection settings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the launch configuration fix for this epic, I want the backend to bind to the correct port and connect to the correct database, so that the system starts cleanly without connection refused errors.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the local deployment configuration, When the system is launched, Then the backend service fully starts and listens on port 18080.
Given the system is running, When the /health endpoint is polled, Then it returns a successful response without connection refused errors.
Given the change is reviewed, When the PR diff is inspected, Then it contains only build, Docker, or deployment settings needed for this slice.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: reduce deployment startup connection refused errors to 0
